svg.aria-label: The agent edits an isolated worktree; your tests run; changes that pass go to an independent check, a spec or a reviewer from another lab, before reaching main. Failures and blocks go back to the agent. All 27 sabotaged changes pass the tests; the check catches 27, and 2 attacks built to beat the spec get through.
